m0-context.title: Load baseline context
m0-context.imperative: Read inherited global doctrine (references/global-crew.md, references/global-everyone.md), then the handoff at .agent-work/301/crew-handoffs/g1-handoff.md in full. Verify the handoff is complete (task, intent, scope, exclusions, required evidence, test mode, stop conditions). Read prior art: scripts/apply_lessons_delta.py (read-only), scripts/agent_work_root.py (read-only, to understand why durable_root() is NOT used here), and the design-it-twice outputs at .agent-work/301/design-it-twice/ (BRIEF.md, COMPARISON.md, candidate-D-retrieval-first.md, candidate-B-assertion-native.md) which carry the frozen record shape (D as spine + grafts from A/B/C) this doc must write up. Attest c1.

postconditions.statement: handoff + prior art + design-it-twice outputs loaded; handoff verified complete

m1-tracked-store.title: Establish the git-tracked episodes/ store path
m1-tracked-store.imperative: Create the repo-root episodes/ directory with exactly one tracked file (episodes/README.md explaining the directory's purpose and pointing at docs/EPISODE_STORE.md) at a GIT-TRACKED path, per handoff C6 and the tracked-path requirement section. Do NOT put anything under .agent-work/ (gitignored). Do not call durable_root(). Verify with the exact commands the handoff specifies.

postconditions.statement: episodes/ is NOT git-ignored (git check-ignore exits 1)

constraints: repo-root episodes/ unless a concrete reason for another tracked location is given
one tracked file minimum (README.md preferred over bare .gitkeep)

m2-doc-grammar.title: Write docs/EPISODE_STORE.md: grammar, partition, retirement policy (layout held open), Stratum A mapping
m2-doc-grammar.imperative: Write docs/EPISODE_STORE.md covering: the episode record grammar (rhyming with apply_lessons_delta.py's Markdown grammar, departing where the episode store's job demands it, saying so explicitly); the mechanical/agent-supplied partition as literal section headings (C2); the retirement POLICY stated + LAYOUT left open as a named seam with both options and neither chosen, held for human ratification at g4 (C3); a concrete field-by-field Stratum A mapping against a worked example with lifecycle standing as a separate dimension from belief strength (C4); per-field assertion addressability in the agent-supplied bin only, with a worked walk-through of disputing one field while a sibling stays active (C5); why the store lives at episodes/ not .agent-work/episodes/, resolving through one named seam and NOT durable_root() (C6); the mechanical-only claim (no ranking/similarity/embedding) plus the obligation on issue #300's manifest (C7); the episode-id scheme chosen fresh on its own merits, not cited as panel unanimity (C8); how cross-worktree sharing works through git itself, needing no durable_root(), unaffected by the epic-lease exception and the read-only fence (C9). Base the content on candidate-D-retrieval-first.md as spine plus the grafts named in COMPARISON.md section 6 (mechanically-unforgeable partition, always-written headings, mandatory non-empty retire reason, single-line enforcement on agent-supplied free text, per-field assertion addressability from B), adapted for the tracked path (episodes/ not .agent-work/episodes/, no durable_root()). This gate ships NO executable code and NO tests -- prose only.

postconditions.statement: docs/EPISODE_STORE.md exists and is not git-ignored

check.command: test -f docs/EPISODE_STORE.md && git check-ignore docs/EPISODE_STORE.md ; test $? -eq 1

postconditions.statement: partition documented as literal section headings (C2)

check.command: grep -qi 'active/' docs/EPISODE_STORE.md && grep -qi 'status.*field' docs/EPISODE_STORE.md && grep -qi 'held' docs/EPISODE_STORE.md

postconditions.statement: Stratum A mapping present as a table/mapping against a worked example (C4)
mechanical-only claim and #300 manifest obligation stated (C7)
cross-worktree sharing via git stated, durable_root() explicitly NOT used (C6, C9)

constraints: no executable code, no tests in this gate
do not choose the retirement layout

grep -qi '^## Mechanical' docs/EPISODE_STORE.md && grep -qi '^## Agent-supplied' docs/EPISODE_STORE.md

m3-verify.title: Run required verification commands and confirm unchanged test baseline
m3-verify.imperative: Run the handoff's Verification Commands section in full and paste the output: git check-ignore episodes/; echo exit=$?, git status --short episodes/ docs/EPISODE_STORE.md, and python -m pytest tests/ -q (use python, not py) to confirm the suite is unchanged (expect the same passed/skipped counts as baseline, since this gate ships no code or tests). Collect this output for IMPLEMENTER_RESULT.

postconditions.statement: pytest suite unchanged (no test files touched, suite still green)

why_trail.why: Handoff verified complete (task, protected intent C2-C9, test mode=inspection-only, allowed scope=docs/EPISODE_STORE.md+episodes/, specific exclusions=LESSONS.md/apply_lessons_delta.py/#300 manifest/#305/#308/retirement-layout, evidence, verification commands, authority, stop conditions all present). Read apply_lessons_delta.py (699 lines, prior-art grammar to rhyme with) and agent_work_root.py durable_root() (understood why NOT used: episodes/ is a tracked repo-root path, cross-worktree sharing happens via git itself, not via redirecting to a main-checkout .agent-work/ that's gitignored anyway). Read design-it-twice BRIEF/COMPARISON/candidate-D/candidate-B: the frozen recommendation is D (retrieval-first) as spine with 5 named grafts (C: mechanically-unforgeable partition; A: always-written headings, mandatory retire reason, single-line enforcement; B: per-field assertion addressability for agent-supplied bin only). Retirement layout (active/retired move vs status field) is explicitly held open per COMPARISON section 7, not mine to choose.

Created episodes/README.md at repo root (tracked path, not under .agent-work/). Verified: git check-ignore episodes/ exits 1 (not ignored); git status --short --untracked-files=all episodes/ shows episodes/README.md; staged it (git add) so the plain git status --short episodes/ postcondition matches directly (a collapsed untracked-dir listing otherwise reads as bare 'episodes/'). No durable_root() call anywhere. README explains purpose, points at docs/EPISODE_STORE.md (not yet written), and distinguishes the store from LESSONS.md.

Wrote docs/EPISODE_STORE.md (10 sections): tracked-path rationale (no durable_root, cross-worktree via git commit/merge, unaffected by epic-lease exception and read-only fence since each commander writes only its own worktree); episode-id scheme chosen fresh on merits (run+seq, zero agent effort, collision-safe, free query primitive) explicitly not citing the retracted panel-unanimity claim; full record grammar worked example with rhyme/depart-from-apply_lessons_delta.py stated explicitly (3 named departures); partition as literal always-written ## Mechanical / ## Agent-supplied / ## Diagnosis (optional) headings, partition-enforcement stated as a g2 writer obligation; per-field assertion addressability worked walkthrough (disputing a4 while a3 stays untouched, diff shown); Stratum A mapping table against the worked example with lifecycle-standing kept a separate dimension from strength; retirement policy stated (excluded-not-deleted, mandatory non-empty reason) with the active/vs-status-field LAYOUT explicitly HELD OPEN, both options stated, neither chosen, bound at g4; mechanical-only claim (no ranking, no similarity, no embedding) plus the #300 manifest obligation stated as an obligation not a design; closing section naming what g2/g3/g4/#305/#308 each still owe. Verified all six postcondition greps pass against the written file.

All required verification commands run and pasted: git check-ignore episodes/ exits 1 (not ignored); git status --short episodes/ docs/EPISODE_STORE.md shows both new files present/stageable (episodes/README.md staged A, docs/EPISODE_STORE.md untracked ??); python -m pytest tests/ -q -> 1157 passed, 2 skipped, 260 subtests passed -- exact match to the handoff's stated baseline, confirming this doc-only gate changed no test behavior.
